messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: p99 latency alert fired for route /v1/generate (us-west) — SLO burn 22% over 5m. Alert: https://alerts.redwood.ai/alerts/abc123 | severity: page | triggered_by: p99>800ms
ryan (oncall): acked. I'm on it. linking pd: https://pd.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-5678
liz (sre): looking at hot nodes now. seeing kvcache evictions + dispatcher queue growth. logs: `kv.evictions: 3.2k/m`, `queue.depth: 420`
carmen (eng-runtime): any recent rollout? model variants?
liz (sre): no recent model rollout. noticed a spike in long sequences from a subset of traffic — prefix lengths jumped. KV reuse dropped.
aj (support): support inbox picking up customer complaints about timeouts, 4 high-priority tickets so far. Customers impacted: two enterprise orgs in us-west.
ryan (oncall): ok first tasks: 1) enable graceful fallback to low-latency variant for /v1/generate in us-west 2) scale dedicated pool by +2 GPUs 3) warm KV cache for top prefixes. Carmen can you kick the fallback?
carmen (eng-runtime): starting rollout of fallback variant (latency-optimized) to 15% traffic in us-west. command: ```
# temp route override
redwoodctl route override --route /v1/generate --region us-west --variant latency-opt --percent 15
```
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Incident INC-5678 acknowledged by ryan (oncall) — escalation paused
liz (sre): I've queued a KV warm job for hot keys, running now. Also bumping dispatcher workers on hot path.
ops-bot: Autoscaler: initiating burst scale for pool us-west-dedicated, requested +2 gpus, ETA ~90s
aj (support): sending templated customer note now: "We're aware of increased latency in us-west and are actively mitigating — we'll update in 10min."
maria (product): are any feature flags tied to long-seq behavior? if this continues we'll need a public status blurb.
ryan (oncall): good — monitor p95/p99. If p99 doesn't drop below 600ms in 6 minutes escalate to SRE lead (liz) and rotate oncall.
liz (sre): kv warm job completed, eviction rate down 70%. p95 improving, p99 still high (~780ms).
carmen (eng-runtime): fallback at 15% showed 40% latency reduction for that cohort. increasing to 40% now as emergency measure. ```
redwoodctl route override --route /v1/generate --region us-west --variant latency-opt --percent 40
```
ryan (oncall): pagerduty-bot: please note escalation window extended; keeping PD acknowledged.
pagerduty-bot: Note recorded. No escalations triggered.
liz (sre): after the +2 GPUs and dispatcher bump + KV warm + fallback, p99 down to 520ms, p95 ~210ms. trend stable for 2m.
am (ops-bot): scale complete, new capacity healthy.
aj (support): updated customers: latency improving, we're monitoring, will update again in 20min.
maria (product): filing a triage doc. please paste any relevant logs/graphs to the doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/triage/INC-5678
ryan (oncall): thanks all. I'll keep thread open for 30m then handoff to next oncall for post-incident monitoring and postmortem. next steps: root-cause analysis (long sequences + cache pressure), consider autoscaler hysteresis tweaks, add guardrails to fallback rollout automation. :thumbsup:
liz (sre): agree. prepping timeline. assigning postmortem owner: carmen.
carmen (eng-runtime): got it. starting notes.
incident-bot: Incident INC-5678 status: mitigated -> monitoring. final p99: 510ms.
ryan (oncall): closing active page. thanks everyone.
